notes: [Orin] Memory Throughput is L2, not DRAM; emitted as memory_l2_throughput_pct.
[Orin] no dram__* counters exist; off-chip bytes are sysmem-miss sectors x 32 B for reads and op_write.sum x 32 B for writes (T005 found the write-miss counter is identically zero).
region_weighted uses the nsys region time with idle gaps counted as zero and is DERIVED; it is the figure comparable with the paper's 22 % SM utilisation.
Stall ratios are reported as exported; their sum per kernel is recorded rather than renormalised (§3.3).
